_: Copy this file to cowork.config.json in the space's folder to change any default. Every key is optional. cowork.config.json is machine-local and never committed.
_phone: This computer's own address for the door on your phone (for example from: tailscale serve --bg --https=8446 http://127.0.0.1:7560). The dashboard then answers that host name too.
_owner: Your name, as James says it in a run ("You report to <owner>"). Left out, he says "the owner".
_agents_dir: Where chief-engineer-john.md is. Left out: ~/.claude/agents, else <hub>\.claude\agents (where the WilsonWorks Workspace installs the CTO org).
_paths: Found on their own when left out: hub (D:\Hub or C:\Hub, whichever holds CLAUDE.md), fleet_ops (<hub>\50-AI\fleet-ops), rigs (<hub drive>\tmp\rigs), claude (claude.exe on the PATH).
_run: model and effort for a composing run, and its hard cap in minutes (2 to 120).
